rationale: With the Chief in the majority and emphasizing emergency-posture restraint plus rejection of a categorical single-race rule, Roberts is most likely to keep the coalition together by writing narrowly. Separate writings are most likely from Kavanaugh/Barrett to stress administrability and Purcell limits, and from Thomas/Alito/Gorsuch to press a textualist, constraint-based dissent on Gingles I denominators.
